Open the [reading-pile removal case](http://maker:4001/?state=collection&feature=readlater&mode=button), then:

1. Mark the first bookmark **Read later**.
2. Open **Read later** in the sidebar.
3. Click its **In read later** button to remove that mark.
4. Return to **All bookmarks**.

Please tell me whether disappearing from the reading pile while remaining in the full collection is the right result. I’ve assumed removing the mark should never delete or archive the bookmark.
